text:
maria: idea: introduce a lightweight 'fence' + handshake lease so enforcement is explicit across hosted/dedicated/private. fence = immutable policy snapshot (allowed_actions,kvcache,kms,egress). handshake mints short lease bound to fence+node cert.
kai: same as leases?
maria: leases + fences = placement + enforcement; fences carry fallback_policy and audit id.
david: perf?
maria: handshake per-lease, runtime caches by lease_id in shared mem.
leah: migration? synthesize fences from old manifests at handshake time. ops-bot: add migration checklist and audit fields.
